propositions: Unrelated nested conftest changes (e.g. tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py) incorrectly trigger all seven mutation shards because mutation-shards.toml uses recursive tests/**/conftest.py glob in global_support.

Runtime tracing of all configured shards reveals pytest loads only six conftests in ancestor chains (tests/conftest.py plus five non-root ancestors), not sibling fixtures, yet the recursive glob treats all conftests as globally affecting every shard.
Across 97 recent Verify runs, seven proven over-trigger candidates wasted 322.6 runner-minutes without increasing coverage because unrelated conftest changes selected all shards.
Per-shard conftest support mapping ensures each non-root conftest appears only in the support lists of shards whose configured tests actually load it via pytest's upward-only ancestor discovery.
A derived ancestor-conftest equality contract verifies that each shard's configured test files/directories expand to a closure of conftests that exactly matches the declared per-shard support list.

After mapping fix, configured shard-test union maintains 374 passed and 1 skipped with zero loss of dependency or coverage, and unrelated conftest changes select no shards while each true ancestor conftest change selects exactly its dependent shards.
